The armored opponent is physically large and encased in substantial armor.
The armored opponent is vulnerable to precise strikes despite the armor.

continuity_links: This page continues an ongoing fight between the white-haired fighter and armored enemies.

locations: A smoke- or fog-filled combat area with very low visibility
lore_facts: Combat on this page takes place in conditions of extreme poor visibility.
Knowledge of the terrain is treated as a major tactical advantage.

plot_events: A white-haired archer-like fighter uses the darkness or obscuring fog as cover.
The attacker notes internally that he knows the terrain better than his enemies.
A heavily armored foe moves forward through the mist.
The attacker ambushes the foe from behind and lands a first hit, marked as 'one'.
The attacker releases or drives a second projectile through the foe's mouth, marked as 'two'.
The armored foe appears shocked and badly wounded by the two rapid strikes.

visual_summary: In a foggy, low-visibility setting, a white-haired fighter crouches with a bow and thinks that blindness or darkness gives him an advantage because he knows the terrain. A bulky armored opponent advances through the haze. The attacker strikes from behind at close range, driving a bladed projectile or arrow through the armored figure, then immediately follows with a second shot that pierces through the victim's open mouth and out the other side.
